_description: Per-account config for account-b. Computes RSI(14) and volatility(20) on daily BTC/USDT candles from Binance WebSocket. Published on :5560 (distinct port — avoids conflict with account-a on :5559). Use with: TRADINEBOTTE_INDICATORS_CONFIG=strategies/indicators_1d.json bash scripts/start_indicators.sh

streams._comment: RSI 14 and rolling volatility on daily BTC/USDT candles
